shortDescription: South Korean Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il said the economy could grow by as much as 3.4% to 3.6% this year, the Yonhap news agency reported on Monday.In July, the government projected growth of 3.5% for the year, while the Bank of Korea forecast 3.3% in August.
